_readme: Hand-edited. content/projects.json is regenerated from GitHub; this file adds the words. Keys under `repos` are exact GitHub repo names. Any repo not listed here still appears on /projects under 'other' using its GitHub description. Set hidden: true to keep a repo off the page. Categories: flagship, tooling, learning, archive, other. `extras` are projects with no public repo.

categories.title: Tooling
categories.blurb: Things we built to solve challenges faster.

nightjar.title: Nightjar
nightjar.summary: A fine-tuned model with its own agent harness, specialised in web exploitation. Built to help MaaSec win CTFs and climb the rankings.

BigSister.title: Big Sister
BigSister.summary: OSINT challenge automation: metadata scraping, steganography checks and automated reverse image search, behind one GUI and CLI.

Tools.title: MaaSec Tools
Tools.summary: One script that sets up a Debian-based machine with everything a member needs for CTFs and security work.

CTF-Writeups.title: CTF Writeups
CTF-Writeups.summary: Our solutions from every competition we play — how we approached each challenge and what worked.

Library.title: Library
Library.summary: Essays, guides and articles by MaaSec members, from reverse-engineering primers to VM setup.

Workshops.title: Workshops
Workshops.summary: Slides, reference links and tooling from our workshops, starting with malware analysis.

BigSister_2.title: Big Sister 2
BigSister_2.summary: The next iteration of Big Sister, in early development.

extras.title: Almo
extras.summary: An interactive study app for medical students, built by our software team and shipped iteratively around real students' feedback.
